title: Approximation of PDE solution manifolds: Sparse-grid interpolation and quadrature
summary: We study fully-discrete approximations and quadratures of infinite-variate functions in abstract Bochner spaces associated with a Hilbert space $X$ and an infinite-tensor-product Jacobi measure.
